document.name: RU-73-03,R3_SOFTWARE_INSTALLATION,_KEEPING,_HANDLI.md
document.title: Software Installation, Keeping, Handling and Maintenance Control

items.statement: The director provides resources, the software engineer performs installation and maintenance, and QA ensures compliance with the approved program.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: 1. Software installation, keeping, handling, storing and maintenance.

items.statement: Software installation is performed under the installation procedure supplied with the controlled software documentation.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: ### 4.1.2 Installation shall be performed according to installation procedure provided within software documentation or using automatic installation procedure if provided with original software.

items.statement: Accompanying test cases verify successful software installation.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: ### 4.1.4 The accompanying test cases shall be used for testing of successfulness of the installation.

items.statement: Original software is permanently archived, installation uses backup media, and backups are distributed across local, optical, and server storage.

sources.source_locator: 4.2 Storage control and control of physical media, page 9, lines 189-216

evidence_quotes.quote_original: 4.2.3 Installation of the software is performed using backup copy.

items.statement: Installation date and hardware platform are recorded in the installation log.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: ### 4.1.3 The installation date and hardware platform shall be recorded in installation log list.

items.statement: Original packages and backup copies are inventoried, permanently retained where required, and media contents are periodically verified.

sources.source_locator: 4.2 Storage control and control of physical media, pages 9-10, lines 205-240

evidence_quotes.quote_original: 4.2.11 Every two year content of above mentioned media has to be verified.
